victoria_memorial.name: Victoria Memorial Hall & Gardens
victoria_memorial.description: Magnificent white Makrana marble monument constructed between 1906 and 1921, blending British, Mughal, and Venetian architectural styles. Houses 25 royal galleries displaying rare historical paintings and artifacts.
victoria_memorial.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon (03:30 PM to 06:00 PM) for garden walks and the evening light-and-sound show.

howrah_bridge.name: Howrah Bridge (Rabindra Setu)
howrah_bridge.description: World-famous balanced cantilever steel bridge spanning the Hooghly River, constructed without a single nut or bolt in 1943. Connects Kolkata with Howrah and serves as the iconic symbol of the City of Joy.
howrah_bridge.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or illuminated night view from a river ferry boat crossing between Howrah and Babu Ghat.

dakshineswar_kali_temple.name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple
dakshineswar_kali_temple.description: Celebrated 19th-century Hindu temple complex founded in 1855 by Rani Rashmoni on the eastern bank of Hooghly River. Famous as the spiritual abode of mystic saint Sri Ramakrishna Paramahamsa, featuring 12 Shiva shrines.
dakshineswar_kali_temple.best_time_to_visit: Early morning (06:00 AM to 09:00 AM) or evening Sandhya Aarti on the riverbank.

kalighat_kali_temple.name: Kalighat Kali Temple
kalighat_kali_temple.description: One of the 51 sacred Shakti Peethas where the right toes of Goddess Sati are believed to have fallen. Revered for centuries as the primary spiritual heart of Kolkata on the banks of the Adi Ganga.
kalighat_kali_temple.best_time_to_visit: 06:00 AM to 08:30 AM on weekdays to avoid intense midday pilgrim queues.

indian_museum.name: Indian Museum (Jadu Ghar)
indian_museum.description: Founded in 1814 by the Asiatic Society of Bengal, this is the ninth oldest regular museum in the world and the largest in India. Features 35 galleries including rare Egyptian mummies, Ashoka Pillar capitals, and dinosaur fossils.

princep_ghat.name: Princep Ghat & Riverfront Promenade
princep_ghat.description: Historic Palladian-style Greek monument built in 1843 in memory of Anglo-Indian scholar James Prinsep. Located right below Vidyasagar Setu, offering romantic wooden boat rides on the Hooghly River.
princep_ghat.best_time_to_visit: Sunset hours (05:00 PM to 07:30 PM) for cool river breezes, illuminated bridge vistas, and local street snacks.

science_city_kolkata.name: Science City Kolkata
science_city_kolkata.description: The largest science center in the Indian subcontinent, featuring an immersive Space Odyssey theater, Dynamotion hall, outdoor Science Park, life-size animatronic dinosaurs, and a ropeway cable car.
science_city_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 04:00 PM for family science exploration and interactive rides.

st_pauls_cathedral.name: St. Paul's Cathedral
st_pauls_cathedral.description: Majestic Anglican cathedral completed in 1847 in Indo-Gothic revival style, known as the first Episcopal Church in the eastern world. Features magnificent stained-glass Florentine frescoes and delicate stone carvings.
st_pauls_cathedral.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (09:00 AM to 12:00 PM) or during Christmas celebrations.

birla_planetarium.name: MP Birla Planetarium
birla_planetarium.description: Asia's oldest and second largest planetarium established in 1963, modeled after the Buddhist Stupa at Sanchi. Equipped with high-tech optomechanical Carl Zeiss projection systems delivering cosmic sky shows.
birla_planetarium.best_time_to_visit: Catch afternoon shows in English, Hindi, or Bengali (advance online booking recommended).

marble_palace.name: Marble Palace Mansion
marble_palace.description: Opulent 1835 neoclassical mansion built by Raja Rajendra Mullick from 126 varieties of Italian marble. Houses priceless original paintings by Sir Peter Paul Rubens, antique Victorian clocks, and a private aviary.
marble_palace.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 02:30 PM (entry requires prior permission pass from West Bengal Tourism).

jorasanko_thakur_bari.name: Jorasanko Thakur Bari (Tagore Memorial)
jorasanko_thakur_bari.description: Ancestral home of Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore, where he was born and breathed his last. Today transformed into the Rabindra Bharati Museum, showcasing the history of the Bengal Renaissance.

belur_math.name: Belur Math (Ramakrishna Mission Headquarters)
belur_math.description: Global headquarters of the Ramakrishna Math and Mission founded by Swami Vivekananda. Its sublime architecture intentionally harmonizes Hindu, Christian, and Islamic motifs as a symbol of universal faith.
belur_math.best_time_to_visit: Evening Aarti (05:30 PM to 07:00 PM) for deep spiritual peace along the riverbank.

birla_mandir_kolkata.name: Birla Mandir (Radha Krishna Temple)
birla_mandir_kolkata.description: Stunning temple constructed entirely of pristine Rajasthani white marble by the Birla industrial family over 26 years. Displays exquisite stone carvings of Hindu epics and Bhagavad Gita shlokas.
birla_mandir_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: Evening hours (06:00 PM to 08:00 PM) when the glowing white marble is radiantly lit up.

alipore_zoo.name: Alipore Zoological Gardens
alipore_zoo.description: India's oldest formal zoological park inaugurated in 1876, home to royal Bengal tigers, one-horned rhinoceros, Asiatic lions, giant Aldabra tortoises, and thousands of winter migratory birds.
alipore_zoo.best_time_to_visit: Morning (09:30 AM to 01:00 PM) between October and March.

botanical_garden_kolkata.name: AJC Bose Indian Botanic Garden & Great Banyan Tree
botanical_garden_kolkata.description: Sprawling 270-acre historic garden in Shibpur founded in 1787. World-famous for the 'Great Banyan Tree'—over 250 years old with a canopy perimeter exceeding 450 meters, resembling a miniature forest.
botanical_garden_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (10:00 AM to 01:00 PM) for nature walks beneath the Great Banyan.

eco_park_new_town.name: Eco Tourism Park (Prakriti Tirtha)
eco_park_new_town.description: Enormous 480-acre modern ecological park in New Town with a vast central lake. Features full-scale replicas of the Seven Wonders of the World, butterfly garden, musical fountain, and kayaking.
eco_park_new_town.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon (03:30 PM to 07:30 PM) for boating and exploring the Seven Wonders.

college_street.name: College Street Boi Para & Indian Coffee House
college_street.description: The world's largest second-hand book market stretching for over a mile. Lined with thousands of academic and literary book stalls, crowned by the historic Indian Coffee House—epicenter of Kolkata's intellectual debates.
college_street.best_time_to_visit: 02:00 PM to 07:00 PM for browsing rare books followed by hot coffee and mutton cutlets at Coffee House.

kumartuli.name: Kumartuli Potter's Colony
kumartuli.description: Centuries-old artisanal settlement along the Hooghly River where skilled potters sculpt breathtaking clay idols of Goddess Durga and other deities using organic alluvial clay and straw.
kumartuli.best_time_to_visit: August to October (leading up to Durga Puja) to witness thousands of idols taking artistic shape.

new_market_kolkata.name: New Market (Sir Stuart Hogg Market)
new_market_kolkata.description: Historical Victorian shopping arcade built in 1874 with a red-brick clock tower. Sells everything from fine silver, leather goods, and handloom sarees to Nahoum & Sons' legendary Jewish bakery treats.
new_market_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: 02:00 PM to 07:30 PM on weekdays (must try plum cake at Nahoum's).

maidan_kolkata.name: The Maidan (Brigade Parade Ground)
maidan_kolkata.description: Vast open green urban expanse stretching from Raj Bhavan to Victoria Memorial, famously referred to as the 'Lungs of Kolkata'. A cultural hotspot for morning cricket, horse-riding, and leisurely strolls.
maidan_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: 06:00 AM to 08:30 AM for morning jogs or late afternoon for carriage rides.

park_street_heritage.name: Park Street Heritage Dining Strip
park_street_heritage.description: Kolkata's most legendary culinary and nightlife avenue, lined with heritage restaurants like Peter Cat (originator of Chelo Kebab), Mocambo, Moulin Rouge, and the iconic colonial tea room Flurys (est. 1927).
park_street_heritage.best_time_to_visit: Lunch at Peter Cat or tea and pastries at Flurys; magically illuminated during Christmas.

rabindra_sarobar.name: Rabindra Sarobar (Dhakuria Lake)
rabindra_sarobar.description: Charming 73-acre man-made lake sanctuary surrounded by ancient rain trees, pedestrian tracks, and historic rowing clubs. A peaceful urban retreat popular among joggers and bird watchers.
rabindra_sarobar.best_time_to_visit: 06:00 AM to 09:00 AM for sunrise walking and fresh lake breeze.

fort_william.name: Fort William
fort_william.description: Colonial fortress constructed in 1781 on the eastern bank of Hooghly River, named after King William III. Built in an irregular octagonal shape covering 70.9 hectares, now serving as the Eastern Command Headquarters.
fort_william.best_time_to_visit: Daytime views from the Maidan promenade (internal entry requires military permission).

writers_building.name: Writers' Building
writers_building.description: Iconic 1777 Greco-Roman red-brick administrative edifice spanning BBD Bagh. Served as the office for junior clerks ('writers') of the East India Company and later the seat of West Bengal Government.
writers_building.best_time_to_visit: Daytime for heritage photography of BBD Bagh architectural square.

raj_bhavan_kolkata.name: Raj Bhavan (Governor's House)
raj_bhavan_kolkata.description: Historic Georgian neoclassical palace modeled on Lord Scarsdale's Kedleston Hall in Derbyshire, built in 1803 by Lord Wellesley. Served as the residence of the Viceroy of India until 1912.
raj_bhavan_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: Daytime views from the grand surrounding gates of BBD Bagh.

shaheed_minar.name: Shaheed Minar (Ochterlony Monument)
shaheed_minar.description: 48-meter-high monument erected in 1828 in honour of Major-General Sir David Ochterlony, renamed Shaheed Minar in 1969 to honor freedom fighters. Features an Egyptian base, Syrian column, and Turkish dome.
shaheed_minar.best_time_to_visit: Evening hours when the monument and surrounding Esplanade area are brightly illuminated.

national_library.name: National Library of India
national_library.description: The largest library in India by volume and public record, housed on the 30-acre Belvedere Estate—former residence of the Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal. Holds over 2.2 million books and rare historical manuscripts.
national_library.best_time_to_visit: 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM for research, quiet reading, and walking the historic grounds.

town_hall_kolkata.name: Kolkata Town Hall
town_hall_kolkata.description: Imposing Roman-Doric heritage landmark constructed in 1813 to host public meetings and grand colonial balls. Today houses the multimedia Kolkata Panorama Museum celebrating the city's socio-cultural history.
town_hall_kolkata.best_time_to_visit: 11:30 AM to 04:00 PM to explore the museum galleries.

general_post_office.name: General Post Office (GPO)
general_post_office.description: Iconic postal headquarters constructed in 1868 featuring an imposing dome, Corinthian columns, and a historic clock. Located on the site of the original 1756 Fort William Black Hole incident.
general_post_office.best_time_to_visit: 10:00 AM to 04:00 PM for philatelic museum exhibits and grand architecture.

millennium_park.name: Millennium Park & Hooghly Promenade
millennium_park.description: Landscaped riverfront park stretching along Strand Road for 2.5 km. Offers manicured lawns, open-air food courts, and boarding docks for evening river cruise ferries on the Ganges.
millennium_park.best_time_to_visit: 04:30 PM to 07:30 PM for sunset river views and scenic boat cruises.

subhash_sarobar.name: Subhash Sarobar Lake
subhash_sarobar.description: Picturesque 40-acre man-made freshwater lake in Beliaghata, named in honor of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. Surrounded by forested walking pathways and popular for angling and tranquil recreation.
subhash_sarobar.best_time_to_visit: 06:30 AM to 09:30 AM for peaceful morning lakeside exercise.

central_park_salt_lake.name: Central Park (Banabitan), Salt Lake
central_park_salt_lake.description: Second largest open green lung in Kolkata Metropolitan Area after the Maidan. Features a sprawling boating lake, rich rose garden, butterfly park, and lush shaded avenues.
central_park_salt_lake.best_time_to_visit: 07:00 AM to 10:00 AM or late afternoon for pedal boating and nature photography.

bitm_museum.name: Birla Industrial & Technological Museum (BITM)
bitm_museum.description: First science museum in independent India established in 1959. Famous for its authentic underground mock coal mine exhibit, television galleries, biotechnology displays, and 3D science theater.
bitm_museum.best_time_to_visit: 10:30 AM to 03:00 PM, highly engaging for school students and inquisitive young minds.

academy_of_fine_arts.name: Academy of Fine Arts
academy_of_fine_arts.description: Premier hub of visual and theatrical arts in Kolkata established in 1933 by Lady Ranu Mukherjee. Features multiple exhibition galleries showing contemporary Indian masters and a celebrated auditorium for Bengali theater.
academy_of_fine_arts.best_time_to_visit: 03:00 PM to 07:30 PM to view art exhibits or attend an evening theater play.

nandan_cultural_centre.name: Nandan Film & Cultural Centre
nandan_cultural_centre.description: Iconic cinema complex inaugurated in 1985 by maestro Satyajit Ray, whose hand-drawn logo crowns the building. The undisputed focal point of Bengali parallel cinema and the Kolkata International Film Festival.
nandan_cultural_centre.best_time_to_visit: Evening film screenings and informal cultural discussions at the open-air courtyard.

netaji_bhawan.name: Netaji Bhawan (Subhas Chandra Bose Memorial)
netaji_bhawan.description: Ancestral residence of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose built in 1909. Preserves Netaji's study room, original bedroom, documents, and the historic 1937 Wanderer car used in his daring 'Great Escape' in 1941.

pareshnath_jain_temple.name: Pareshnath Jain Temple (Shitalnath Ji)
pareshnath_jain_temple.description: Dazzling 19th-century temple complex built by Ray Badridas Bahadur. Celebrated for ornate European mirror-mosaics, Italian marble floors, stained-glass domes, and sculpted manicured flower gardens.
pareshnath_jain_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (07:00 AM to 11:30 AM) to admire the radiant mirror and glass artwork.

nakhoda_mosque.name: Nakhoda Mosque
nakhoda_mosque.description: Principal mosque of Kolkata built in 1926 in Indo-Saracenic style using red sandstone from Agra, modeled after Akbar's tomb in Sikandra. Its prayer hall accommodates over 10,000 devotees.
nakhoda_mosque.best_time_to_visit: Daytime outside prayer hours or during the evening food festival during Ramadan.

st_johns_church.name: St. John's Church & Charnock Mausoleum
st_johns_church.description: One of Kolkata's earliest public buildings constructed in 1787 out of Chunar stone. Contains the octagonal mausoleum of Kolkata's traditional founder Job Charnock and Johann Zoffany's famous Last Supper painting.
st_johns_church.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (09:00 AM to 12:30 PM) for serene colonial heritage exploration.

metcalfe_hall.name: Metcalfe Hall
metcalfe_hall.description: Classical heritage building erected in 1844 inspired by the Temple of the Winds in Athens, featuring 30 gigantic Corinthian pillars. Now restored by ASI as a permanent museum showcasing Kolkata's living history.
metcalfe_hall.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 04:00 PM for viewing historical photo archives and architecture.

currency_building.name: The Currency Building
currency_building.description: Majestic Italianate three-storey heritage building built in 1833 that once housed the Reserve Bank of India and issue of currency notes. Restored by the ASI with an awe-inspiring skylit central atrium.
currency_building.best_time_to_visit: 10:30 AM to 04:30 PM for curated national art and sculpture exhibitions.

mothers_wax_museum.name: Mother's Wax Museum
mothers_wax_museum.description: India's first full-scale wax museum located opposite Eco Park in New Town, showcasing over 50 lifelike wax statues of iconic personalities including Rabindranath Tagore, Amitabh Bachchan, and Mahatma Gandhi.
mothers_wax_museum.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to evening session combined with a visit to neighboring Eco Park.

smaranika_tram_museum.name: Smaranika Tram Museum
smaranika_tram_museum.description: Charming vintage tramcar museum set inside a restored 1938 wooden tram stationed at the Esplanade loop. Displays antique tram tickets, conductor badges, equipment, and a cozy retro cafe.
smaranika_tram_museum.best_time_to_visit: 02:00 PM to 06:30 PM for vintage tram nostalgia and afternoon tea.

burrabazar.name: Burrabazar Wholesale Trading Bazaar
burrabazar.description: Kolkata's most historic and expansive commercial wholesale market, originating as a village textile mart in the 17th century. A bustling labyrinth of narrow lanes brimming with fabrics, spices, and festival decorations.
burrabazar.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM for wholesale shopping and authentic north Indian street savories.

gariahat_market.name: Gariahat Traditional Market
gariahat_market.description: South Kolkata's most vibrant commercial epicenter, renowned across Bengal for traditional handloom Jamdani and Baluchari sarees, pottery, oxidized jewelry, and legendary kathi rolls and telebhaja.
gariahat_market.best_time_to_visit: 04:00 PM to 08:30 PM for lively street bargains and mouth-watering street delicacies.

hatibagan_market.name: Hatibagan Market & Star Theatre
hatibagan_market.description: Historic north Kolkata market area famous for traditional cotton sarees, silk apparel, and the iconic Star Theatre (est. 1883), which hosted the pioneering performances of Bengali drama maestro Girish Chandra Ghosh.
hatibagan_market.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to evening for traditional Bengali attire shopping.

south_city_mall.name: South City Mall
south_city_mall.description: One of East India's largest and most frequented premier shopping complexes, housing global high-street brands, multi-cuisine restaurants, a sprawling multiplex, and lively weekend events.
south_city_mall.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to late evening for relaxed shopping, cinema, and fine dining.

city_centre_salt_lake.name: City Centre 1 Mall, Salt Lake
city_centre_salt_lake.description: Award-winning non-mall architectural destination conceived by renowned architect Charles Correa. Features open-to-sky pedestrian plazas, a central amphitheater (Kund), and an energetic mix of street food and brand outlets.
city_centre_salt_lake.best_time_to_visit: Evening hours (05:00 PM to 09:30 PM) for the vibrant open-air plaza ambiance.

armenian_church.name: Armenian Church of the Holy Nazareth
armenian_church.description: Kolkata's oldest surviving church built in 1724, testifying to the influential Armenian mercantile community that settled in Bengal before the British. Features exquisite interior frescoes and ancient gravestones.
armenian_church.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (09:30 AM to 01:00 PM) for peaceful reflection in the historic courtyard.

vidyasagar_setu.name: Vidyasagar Setu (Second Hooghly Bridge)
vidyasagar_setu.description: India's longest cable-stayed bridge spanning 823 meters across the Hooghly River, named in honour of educator Pandit Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar. A modern civil engineering marvel offering panoramic views of Kolkata.
vidyasagar_setu.best_time_to_visit: Sunset and night when the sweeping cable pylons are gracefully illuminated.
